title: Data retention
description: Finished records and data in the recycle bin are removed automatically every day once they are older than their retention period. The periods set here apply to this instance only and are not synced to other devices.
taskDescription: Finished task runs with their events and notifications. Queued and running tasks are not affected.
saved: Retention updated; it applies to the next cleanup
runDescription: Apply the periods above now instead of waiting for the daily cleanup. Removed records cannot be restored.
runSuccess: Removed {tasks} task records, {logs} log entries and {entries} recycle bin entries
runNothing: Nothing is older than its retention period
deletedDescription: Servers, scripts and AI conversations in the recycle bin. They can be restored within this period, including a server's saved credentials.
recycleDescription: Deleted servers, scripts and AI conversations are kept for the period above. A restored server does not get its share grants back; a restored conversation is read-only history.
recycleLoadFailed: Failed to load the recycle bin
